title: Use the Zone Config Aveva API page to view lane zone assignments and (if needed) update zone configuration
summary: Use the Zone Config Aveva API page to view the current lane-to-zone assignments and processing sequence numbers via “Get Zone Configuration.” If the interface is being used for operational flexibility, use “Update Zone Configuration” to modify zone settings, noting that zone configuration changes are generally not used because zones are described as “equal zones.”
when_to_use: When you need visibility into how lanes are assigned to zones and what processing sequence numbers are configured, using the Zone Config Aveva API page’s “Get Zone Configuration” function. Optionally, when the interface is being used to modify zone settings for operational flexibility via “Update Zone Configuration.”
not_for: Do not rely on zone configuration updates for operational behavior unless the system is known to support/require them; the source states zone configuration changes are generally not used because zones are “equal zones.”
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the Zone Config Aveva API page checks (Get Zone Configuration) and, if applicable, apply zone updates using Update Zone Configuration.
access_or_tools_needed: Zone Config Aveva API page interface

visual_references.description: Zone Config Aveva API page interface showing lane assignments, their respective zones, processing sequence numbers, and the “Get Zone Configuration” / “Update Zone Configuration” controls.

steps.expected_result: The Zone Config Aveva API page is displayed with the interface elements for viewing lane assignments/zones/processing sequence numbers and the “Get Zone Configuration” and “Update Zone Configuration” functions.

steps.title: Use “Get Zone Configuration” to fetch the current configuration of all lanes
steps.purpose: Retrieve the current lane-to-zone configuration for all lanes so you can verify lane assignments, zones, and processing sequence numbers.
steps.instruction: Use the “Get Zone Configuration” function to fetch the current configuration of all lanes.
steps.expected_result: The interface returns the current configuration of all lanes, providing visibility into how each lane is set up within the system.
steps.healthy_condition: The results display lane assignments along with each lane’s respective zone and processing sequence numbers.
steps.failure_condition: The interface does not return lane configuration data for “all lanes.”
stop_or_escalate_if: If the interface does not return lane configuration data for “all lanes,” stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote: Get Zone Configuration ... Fetches the current configuration of all lanes, offering ... visibility into how each lane is set up within the system.

steps.title: Verify lane assignments, each lane’s zone, and processing sequence numbers in the results

steps.instruction: On the “Get Zone Configuration” results, verify that the interface shows lane assignments, each lane’s respective zone, and the processing sequence numbers.
steps.expected_result: You can observe lane assignments mapped to zones and see processing sequence numbers for those lanes in the results display.
steps.healthy_condition: The results clearly show lane assignments, each lane’s respective zone, and processing sequence numbers.
steps.failure_condition: The results are missing lane assignments, zones, or processing sequence numbers (or do not match the expected display of the interface).

steps.title: If needed, use “Update Zone Configuration” to modify zone settings
steps.purpose: Apply zone configuration changes only when the interface is being used for operational flexibility.

steps.expected_result: The “Update Zone Configuration” function is available and can be used to modify zone settings via the interface.
steps.healthy_condition: You can access the “Update Zone Configuration” function on the Zone Config Aveva API page.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the “Update Zone Configuration” function, or the update cannot be applied through the interface.
stop_or_escalate_if: Because the source states zone configuration changes are generally not used due to “equal zones,” avoid relying on updates for operational behavior unless the system is known to support/require them.

If “Update Zone Configuration” is used, the update intent is consistent with the guidance that zone configuration changes are generally not used because zones are “equal zones.”
